subject: SIG questionnaire initiation — follow-up & clarification
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmecorp.com>, Emily Chang <emily@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation — next steps and clarifying Qs

Hi Samir / Emily,

Thanks again for the time on the call this morning — great context on AcmeCorp's roadmap and where Redwood could help streamline inference costs for your prod workflows. As discussed, I've attached the SIG questionnaire (SIG-Questionnaire-Acme.xlsx) to kick off the security intake.

Quick recap and what we need to keep things moving:
- We'll start by answering the SIG (CAIQ-style) questions and include any supporting artifacts (SOC 2 summary, encryption docs).
- Please confirm whether you prefer the completed SIG as an Excel file or uploaded to a secure portal (OneTrust / SharePoint).
- For scope: can you confirm whether the integration will involve PHI/medical data or other regulated data? That will determine whether we recommend Dedicated / Private deployment or if Hosted with specific controls is acceptable.

A few clarifying questions from our side to ensure the answers are accurate:
1) Current SOC 2 posture — do you need the full Type II report or is a SOC 2 summary and control matrix sufficient up front?
2) Do you require a signed BAA? If so, we can route this to legal and offer DocuSign.
3) Any specific data residency requirements (EU/UK) or a list of prohibited subprocessors?
4) Who is the best security contact for technical follow ups (scanner results, network/IP allowlist)?

Proposed timeline: we can return an initial set of SIG answers + SOC2 summary under NDA within 2-3 business days, and follow with the more detailed attachments as required. If helpful, happy to set a 30-min follow-up tomorrow afternoon to walk through any sticky items.

Attaching: SIG-Questionnaire-Acme.xlsx (stub)

Thanks —

Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation — next steps and clarifying Qs

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick follow-up and the SIG. A few answers and clarifications from our side:

- SOC 2: We currently have SOC 2 Type II in progress (audit in Q3 2027). For intake, our procurement team typically accepts a SOC 2 summary + SOC 2 Type I evidence or interim report. We will likely need the full Type II once completed.
- PHI: Potentially yes — some of the telemetry from our devices is considered PHI when correlated to patient IDs. We'll need to understand your BAA posture and recommended deployment (we may require Dedicated or Private).
- BAA: We do require a signed BAA for any vendor processing PHI. Please route legal contact info if you have a standard BAA/template.
- Intake format: Excel is fine (SIG), but procurement prefers we get a copy in our intake portal as well — I attached our Acme-Security-Intake.pdf for reference.

Security contact for technical Qs: security@acmecorp.com (this goes to our InfoSec manager). Procurement lead: emily@acmecorp.com.

Can you confirm whether Redwood will persist prompts/logs by default for hosted API customers and what the retention window/controls look like? Also: what encryption at rest and in transit do you provide, and which KMS options do you support?

Happy to do a 30-min call tomorrow at 3pm PT to walk through — EMILY, does that time work for procurement?

Thanks,
Samir
Sr. Product Security Manager
AcmeCorp
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmecorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Emily Chang <emily@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation — SIG answers & quick clarifications

Hi Samir — thanks for the details and the intake. I’m Redwood’s security/sales engineering lead and I’ll own the SIG responses and the technical follow-up.

Quick answers to Samir's questions:
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II (reporting period ending 2026). We can share a SOC 2 summary and control matrix now; full report will be shared under NDA. I attached a short SOC2-Summary-Redwood-2026.pdf (stub).
- PHI / BAA: We support HIPAA workloads. We offer a standard BAA; happy to execute via DocuSign. For PHI we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments to minimize multi-tenant surface area.
- Data retention & logs: Hosted API does not retain customer prompt data for more than the configured retention window (default 30 days) unless retention is explicitly enabled. Dedicated/Private options are available for longer term retention controls and isolation.
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ for in-transit; AES-256 at rest. We support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments and several cloud KMS options for Dedicated.
- Subprocessors: We maintain a subprocessors list; we can provide the current list and flag any that are disallowed.

Plan: we'll start filling the SIG (attached Excel) and return a first-pass set of answers by end of day Friday (2 business days). For items that require artifacts (e.g., network diagrams, pen test reports) we'll indicate 'available under NDA' and route those to legal.

Proposed next steps:
1) Marissa — we'll populate the SIG and upload to the Drive link (https://drive.redwood.example.com/shared/Acme/SIG-Responses) unless you prefer we return the Excel directly.
2) Samir / Emily — please confirm NDA/BAA preference and whether procurement wants the intake uploaded to your portal.
3) If helpful, Camila can join the 30-min call tomorrow at 3pm PT to run through any technical items.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
